entries.partTitle: Architecture of the 1,000,000 Particle WebGPU Compute Engine

spec.title: System Architecture: Architecture of the 1,000,000 Particle WebGPU Compute Engine

right.label: Modern WebGPU Compute Pipeline
content: Zero-copy on-chip storage and shared memory

steps.caption: Master system overview illustrates the complete million-particle WebGPU compute pipeline, from physics simulation to indirect draw dispatch.
Deep inspection examines ping-pong double buffer alternation, cooperative workgroup shared memory caching, and indirect argument buffers.
Comparative profiling evaluates compute pass duration, render pass rasterization overhead, and sixty frames per second frame budget margins.
Final defense matrix audit certifies struct byte alignments, warp thread sizing, shared memory limits, and automated device loss recovery.
